Linux cache storage failures now report the operation, path and recovery action. Complete caches remain usable read-only; unreadable references are preserved. TensorRT validates new plans before publication, rejects zero-exit truncated output and latches async failures instead of rebuilding repeatedly.

Targeted checks used real ENOSPC in a private tmpfs, Unix permissions and explicitly injected EDQUOT. Reference outputs remained exact after restoring access or using read-only caches. Refused publication no longer reports success; duplicate failed attempts fell from two to one, and an unreadable reference no longer triggers a replacement build. No FPS gain is claimed.

See [the qualification report](https://github.com/Ta2b/mpv-AnimeJaNai-HDR/blob/release/docs/qualification/lot-12-cache-storage-20261016.md). Native qualification on other platforms remains separate. Platform assets appear as independent builds finish.
